disputedTerms.title: Altaic (disputed proposal)
disputedTerms.explanation: Glottolog 5.3 does not treat Altaic as a demonstrated family; Turkic, Mongolic-Khitan, Tungusic, Japonic, and Koreanic are mapped separately.

disputedTerms.title: Amerind (disputed proposal)
disputedTerms.explanation: Glottolog 5.3 does not accept Amerind as one genealogical family; the Indigenous languages of the Americas are represented by many independent families and isolates.

disputedTerms.title: Khoisan (geographic cover term)
disputedTerms.explanation: Khoisan is not a single demonstrated family. Khoe-Kwadi, Kxa, Tuu, Hadza, and Sandawe are shown as separate lineages.

disputedTerms.title: Nilo-Saharan (disputed proposal)
disputedTerms.explanation: Glottolog 5.3 does not accept Nilo-Saharan as a single family; its proposed constituents are mapped as separate lineages.

disputedTerms.title: Papuan (geographic cover term)
disputedTerms.explanation: Papuan is a geographic label for many non-Austronesian languages of New Guinea and nearby islands, not one genealogical family.
